changelog:
edgeone-clawscan 1.0.15 introduces privacy controls and improved deployment safety:

- Added optional AIG_CLOUD_LOOKUP environment variable to fully disable all outbound HTTPS lookups (cloud threat/CVE, default is enabled).
- Documented minimum data sent when cloud lookup is enabled—never sends skill bodies, chats, or workspace files, only skill name, source label, or OpenClaw version.
- Added provenance and verification sections: clarify publisher, registry caveats, and checking against official releases.
- Cautions and pre-run checklist emphasize verifying the binary on PATH and taking care with live Gateway probes.
- Clarified setup for self-hosted threat intelligence, stricter air-gap guidance, and how to force local-only operation.
